title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.38397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. translated_title: SimTrace：基于真实依据的多模态用户轨迹生成用于在线用户建模
translated_abstract: 虚拟客户端为支持A/B测试、推荐系统开发和界面评估等应用提供了一种经济高效的方案。然而，构建虚拟客户端需要获取大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹数据。这类数据难以获得，因为专有日志受到隐私限制，而小型企业往往缺乏足够的流量。因此，现有的公开数据集要么抽象掉了细粒度的用户交互细节，要么虽保留了丰富的上下文但仍局限于特定平台且规模较小。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了SimTrace，这是一个通过计算机使用客户端代理生成忠实、细粒度的合成多模态点击流的框架，该代理以真实用户轨迹和给定的网页环境为基础。SimTrace对真实交互进行匿名化处理，并构建给定网页环境的模拟孪生体，然后利用这两者来生成合成的...
tldr: SimTrace是一个以真实用户轨迹和网页环境为依据，利用计算机使用客户端代理生成忠实、细粒度合成多模态点击流的框架，旨在为虚拟客户端构建和在线用户建模提供大规模数据支持。
en_tdlr: SimTrace is a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams via a computer-use client agent grounded in real user trajectories and web environments, enabling large-scale data support for virtual client construction and online user modeling.
